meta.name: analogy-quality-assessment
meta.description: Assess analogy depth (surface/structural/systemic). Determines whether an analogy warrants transfer investment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估类比深度，判断是否值得迁移投资
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统评估类比质量并决定是否应用类比推理
copy.tagline_en: Assess analogy depth to decide transfer investment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically evaluate analogy quality and decide on applying analogical reasoning

howto.what: Claude 会分析你给出的类比，判断它是表面、结构还是系统层面的相似度，并告知这个类比是否值得用来做知识迁移。
howto.when: 当你提供一个类比映射（比如“A之于B如同C之于D”）时触发。

say.text: 评价这个类比：老师之于学生如同导游之于游客。
say.note: Claude 会评估该类比的深度并给出建议。

say.text: 帮我分析这个类比是否值得迁移学习。
say.note: Claude 会基于深度分析返回结论。

howto.what_en: Claude evaluates the analogy you provide, classifying its depth as surface, structural, or systemic, and determines whether it is worth transferring knowledge.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an analogy mapping (e.g., 'A is to B as C is to D').

say_en.text: Rate this analogy: teacher is to student as guide is to tourist.
say_en.note: Claude will assess depth and give advice.

say_en.text: Analyze if this analogy is worth for transfer learning.
say_en.note: Claude will return conclusion based on depth analysis.
